title: Premium Bedroom
overview: A modern premium bedroom design that blends comfort and elegance through ambient lighting and luxury textures.
description: This bedroom interior is designed for peaceful relaxation with soft tones, upholstered headboards, wooden flooring, and a cozy false ceiling. The layout emphasizes warmth and space optimization, creating a perfect retreat for restful nights.

title: Bedroom with Modular False Ceiling
overview: An elegant bedroom featuring a custom modular false ceiling and warm indirect lighting for a luxurious ambience.
description: This space showcases a contemporary bedroom concept with layered ceiling lights, wooden textures, and an accent wall. The modular ceiling adds both dimension and charm, making the room vibrant yet calming.

title: Modular Salon
overview: A stylish modular salon interior designed for customer comfort and professional functionality.
description: This salon interior integrates sleek mirrors, modern seating, organized workstations, and focused lighting. The modular setup enhances workflow for stylists while giving clients a luxury grooming experience.

title: Mobile Showroom
overview: A compact yet premium mobile showroom interior optimized for brand presentation and customer interaction.
description: This mobile showroom design offers high-end display units, bright lighting, and flexible shelving suitable for on-the-go exhibitions or retail events. The space efficiently combines aesthetics with practicality.

title: Restaurant
overview: A premium restaurant interior combining ambient lighting with contemporary dining aesthetics.
description: The restaurant is designed to deliver a warm and luxurious dining experience. From the textured walls to elegant furniture and ceiling lights, every detail enhances the atmosphere for guests to enjoy meals in style.

title: Modular Kitchen
overview: A sleek modular kitchen design emphasizing space efficiency, functionality, and modern aesthetics.
description: This kitchen combines matte finishes, soft-close drawers, and under-cabinet lighting. The L-shaped layout ensures maximum storage and easy accessibility, making it both stylish and practical.

title: Fashion Shop
overview: A trendy fashion showroom interior designed to highlight products through elegant lighting and layout.
description: This boutique-style space offers open display racks, full-height mirrors, and clean lighting to emphasize the clothing collection. The modern textures and color palette make the store visually appealing to customers.

title: CA Office
overview: A modern CA office setup designed for focus, organization, and a professional atmosphere.
description: The office features a minimalist design with ergonomic furniture, smart storage, and calm lighting. A subtle color palette enhances focus and creates an inviting yet efficient workspace for clients and employees.

title: Wardrobe
overview: A sleek modular wardrobe design offering a perfect blend of functionality and modern aesthetics.
description: This wardrobe setup features sliding shutters, integrated mirrors, and custom shelving for efficient organization. The design optimizes space while maintaining a polished, premium look suitable for any bedroom.
